## Presentation Countdown

```{=html}
<style>
  #cc-timer {
    font-size: 348px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    line-height: 1.1;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    transition: color 0.6s ease;
  }
  #cc-timer.cc-flash {
    animation: cc-pop 0.6s ease;
  }
  @keyframes cc-pop {
    0%   { transform: scale(1); }
    40%  { transform: scale(1.06); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
  }
  #cc-minute-label {
    font-size: 40px;
    color: #7f8c8d;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    min-height: 1.4em;
  }
  .cc-btn {
    font-size: 24px;
    padding: 20px 40px;
    color: white;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 0 8px;
  }
  .cc-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }
  #cc-start { background-color: #27ae60; }
  #cc-pause { background-color: #f39c12; }
  #cc-reset { background-color: #e74c3c; }
  #cc-legend {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-top: 40px;
    font-size: 26px;
    color: #2c3e50;
  }
  #cc-legend span {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  #cc-legend i {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
</style>

<div id="cc-container" style="text-align: center;">
  <div id="cc-timer">05:00</div>
  <div id="cc-minute-label">Ready — 5 minutes</div>

  <button id="cc-start" class="cc-btn">Start 5:00</button>
  <button id="cc-pause" class="cc-btn" disabled>Pause</button>
  <button id="cc-reset" class="cc-btn">Reset</button>

  <div id="cc-legend"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const TOTAL = 300; // 5 minutes

  // One colour per minute band, from the first minute down to the last.
  // Index 0 = minute 5 (5:00–4:01), index 4 = final minute (1:00–0:01).
  const BAND_COLORS = [
    "#2c3e50", // 5:00 – 4:01  slate
    "#2980b9", // 4:00 – 3:01  blue
    "#27ae60", // 3:00 – 2:01  green
    "#f39c12", // 2:00 – 1:01  orange
    "#e74c3c"  // 1:00 – 0:01  red
  ];
  const DONE_COLOR = "#8e44ad"; // Time's up

  let timeLeft = TOTAL;
  let interval = null;
  let currentBand = -1;

  const timerEl = document.getElementById("cc-timer");
  const labelEl = document.getElementById("cc-minute-label");
  const startBtn = document.getElementById("cc-start");
  const pauseBtn = document.getElementById("cc-pause");
  const resetBtn = document.getElementById("cc-reset");
  const legendEl = document.getElementById("cc-legend");

  // Build the legend so everyone can see what each colour means.
  BAND_COLORS.forEach((c, i) => {
    const minsLeft = BAND_COLORS.length - i;
    const s = document.createElement("span");
    s.innerHTML = `<i style="background:${c}"></i>${minsLeft} min`;
    legendEl.appendChild(s);
  });

  function fmt(sec) {
    const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    const s = sec % 60;
    return String(m).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(s).padStart(2, "0");
  }

  // Which band are we in? 300..241 -> 0, 240..181 -> 1, ..., 60..1 -> 4
  function bandFor(sec) {
    if (sec <= 0) return BAND_COLORS.length; // done
    return BAND_COLORS.length - Math.ceil(sec / 60);
  }

  function applyBand(sec, animate) {
    const band = bandFor(sec);
    if (band === currentBand) return;
    currentBand = band;

    if (band >= BAND_COLORS.length) {
      timerEl.style.color = DONE_COLOR;
      labelEl.textContent = "Time's up!";
    } else {
      timerEl.style.color = BAND_COLORS[band];
      const minsLeft = BAND_COLORS.length - band;
      labelEl.textContent = minsLeft === 1 ? "Final minute" : `${minsLeft} minutes left`;
    }

    if (animate) {
      timerEl.classList.remove("cc-flash");
      void timerEl.offsetWidth; // restart animation
      timerEl.classList.add("cc-flash");
    }
  }

  function render(animate) {
    timerEl.textContent = timeLeft > 0 ? fmt(timeLeft) : "00:00";
    applyBand(timeLeft, animate);
  }

  function tick() {
    if (timeLeft > 0) {
      timeLeft--;
      render(true);
    }
    if (timeLeft <= 0) {
      stop();
      startBtn.disabled = true;
      startBtn.textContent = "Done";
    }
  }

  function start() {
    if (interval) return;
    interval = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    startBtn.textContent = "Running…";
    pauseBtn.disabled = false;
  }

  function stop() {
    clearInterval(interval);
    interval = null;
    pauseBtn.disabled = true;
  }

  function pause() {
    stop();
    startBtn.disabled = false;
    startBtn.textContent = "Resume";
  }

  function reset() {
    stop();
    timeLeft = TOTAL;
    currentBand = -1;
    startBtn.disabled = false;
    startBtn.textContent = "Start 5:00";
    labelEl.textContent = "Ready — 5 minutes";
    render(false);
  }

  startBtn.addEventListener("click", start);
  pauseBtn.addEventListener("click", pause);
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", reset);


  render(false);
})();
</script>
```
